name: platform-orchestrator
description: Reusable wave-based platform orchestration skills for planning, branch/PR execution, tracker sync, QA evidence, and closeout across products.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, ship, verify, and track multi-wave platform work.
interface.longDescription: Platform Orchestrator packages reusable Codex skills for turning large product/platform backlogs into agent lanes, implementation waves, branch and PR gates, GitHub/Notion tracker updates, QA evidence, and safe closeout. It is intentionally generic so the same pattern can be reused across ventures without hard-coding one repository.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Platform Orchestrator to turn this backlog into shippable waves, branch/PR gates, tracker updates, and verification evidence.
